Artificial Intelligence is one of the most important technologies in the modern world . It enables computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence . AI is becoming increasingly useful in education, healthcare, business, transportation, agriculture, and many other industries . The responsible use of AI requires transparency, security, fairness, and human supervision .
